name: Floating Chat Nova
author: akashahmed29

sections.description:
Floating Chat Nova lets you add modern floating chat buttons to your WordPress website without writing a single line of code.

Increase customer engagement by allowing visitors to contact you instantly through popular messaging platforms such as Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, and Instagram.

Everything can be customized from an intuitive admin panel, including button style, colors, position, animations, device visibility, status, multiple accounts, and much more.

Supported Chat Channels

  • Facebook Messenger
  • WhatsApp
  • Telegram
  • Instagram
  • Custom Chat Links

Free Features

  • Facebook Messenger Chat Button
  • WhatsApp Chat Button
  • Telegram Chat Button
  • Instagram Chat Button
  • Custom Chat Channel
  • Floating Chat Widget
  • Custom Welcome Message
  • Custom Button Text
  • Multiple Button Styles
  • Left or Right Position
  • Button Size Control
  • Custom Colors
  • Icon & Label Toggle
  • Desktop Visibility
  • Mobile Visibility
  • Scroll Offset Control
  • Entrance Animations
  • Notification Badge
  • Online / Offline Status
  • Enable / Disable Widget
  • Responsive Design
  • Lightweight & Fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the floating-chat-nova folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Floating Chat Nova from the WordPress Dashboard.
  4. Configure your preferred chat channels and save the settings.
sections.faq:
Which messaging platforms are supported?

Floating Chat Nova supports Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, and custom chat links.

Can I change the button colors?

Yes. You can customize the button colors, icon colors, background, and other appearance settings.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The plugin is fully responsive and lets you choose whether to display the widget on desktop, mobile, or both.

Can I display multiple chat accounts?

Yes. You can configure multiple chat accounts and choose a default account.

Does the plugin affect website performance?

No. Floating Chat Nova is lightweight and optimized for fast loading.
